Lemma
[Convolution singularity estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0412, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0413, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0414 1. appe:1.5\group Green Functions

If $|\Psi (x,z)|\le C d(x,z)^{a-n}$ and $|\Theta (z,y)|\le C d(y,z)^{b-n}$ with $0<a,b<n$, then \[ \left|\int _M\Psi (x,z)\Theta (z,y)\, d\mu (z)\right| \le \begin{cases} C’d(x,y)^{a+b-n}& a+b<n,\\ C’(1+|\log d(x,y)|)& a+b=n,\\ C’& a+b>n. \end{cases} \]
